name: copyist-lit
pre: {const fp=window.__fp, f=fp.people.figs.find((q)=>q.id==='copyist').fig, a=f.yaw+0.9, h=f.y+1.45*f.k, c=fp.camera; c.position.set(f.x+Math.sin(a)*2.6, h+0.15, f.z+Math.cos(a)*2.6); c.lookAt(f.x, h-0.15, f.z); c.updateMatrixWorld();}
